name: Blight Parchment
description: A weak effigy magic parchment used by children to torment others, that Kodolaag uses against an Azorius elocutor and guards.

timeline.summary: Kodolaag uses blight parchment to drive the Azorius elocutor away, and Zita fears arrest.
timeline.quote: He grabs his head with both hands, screaming at the top of his lungs.

timeline.summary: Zita brings a guard's drawing in a coloring book to life, and Kodolaag draws every guard on blight parchment and tears the pages, incapacitating them.
timeline.quote: Electric magic ignites the paper, and the guards wail out in unison as if they're being burned alive.
